root.name: オクシデンタル・ペトロリアム

companies.name: ウエスタン・ミッドストリーム・パートナーズ

relations.text: 2025年、2024年、2023年の関連当事者向け売上のうち、WES向けの原油とNGLの販売が53%、58%、63%を占めた
relations.text_en: Sales of Occidental-produced oil and NGL to WES made up 53%, 58% and 63% of related party sales in 2025, 2024 and 2023

source.label: Occidental Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2025, 2024 and 2023, sales of Company-produced oil and NGL to WES accounted for 53 %, 58 % and 63 % of related party sales, respectively.

relations.text: 2025年、2024年、2023年に、自社産の原油・NGL・天然ガスの集積、処理、精製の料金をWESに払った
relations.text_en: In 2025, 2024 and 2023 Occidental paid WES fees to gather, process and treat its produced oil, NGL and natural gas

source.label: Occidental Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2025, 2024 and 2023, services primarily related to fees charged by WES to gather, process and treat the Company produced oil, NGL and natural gas.

companies.name: バークシャー・ハサウェイ

relations.text: OxyChem事業の全持ち分を97億ドルの現金でバークシャー・ハサウェイに売る契約を、2025年10月に結んだ
relations.text_en: In October 2025 Occidental agreed to sell all equity interests in OxyChem to Berkshire Hathaway for $9.7 billion in cash

source.label: Occidental Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In October 2025, the Company announced entry into a purchase and sale agreement with Berkshire Hathaway to sell all of the issued and outstanding equity interests in OxyChem in an all-cash transaction for $9.7 billion

relations.text: 初の商業規模の大気直接回収施設を、ブラックロックと合弁会社で開発している
relations.text_en: Occidental and BlackRock formed a joint venture to develop the first commercial scale direct air capture facility

source.label: Occidental Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The Company and BlackRock formed a joint venture for the continued development of the first commercial scale direct air capture facility.

companies.name: ドルフィン・エナジー

relations.text: カタールのドルフィン・エナジー事業に、上流で24.5%の権益を持って参加している
relations.text_en: Occidental partners in the Dolphin Energy Project in Qatar with a 24.5% interest in the upstream operations

source.label: Occidental Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In Qatar, the Company partners in the Dolphin Energy Project, an investment that is comprised of two separate economic interests. The Company has a 24.5% interest in the upstream operations to develop and produce NGL, natural gas and condensate from Qatar’s North Field through mid-2032.

relations.text: 中東では、ドルフィン・エナジー・リミテッド(DEL)に持分法で投資している
relations.text_en: Occidental invests in DEL in the Middle East under the equity method

source.label: Occidental Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: invests in entities that conduct similar activities, such as WES in the United States and DEL in the Middle East, which are accounted for as equity method investments.
